research: Read the strategy packet (true facts, campaign facts, nothing earlier for this product) and docs/research/2026-10-black-friday-and-bag-ads.md: BFCM statics win with one big visual and one offer line; gifting and 'what is in the box' formats; hooks that state the offer in the first line.
The client's four ideas for this batch map to one project each: one for you, one for her (P01); Black Friday prices are live now (P02); Christmas gifting (P03); everything you get in the set (P04).

Live libracases.com product page (2026-10-25): $69.95 vs $174.88 (SAVE 60%), banner 'EARLY BLACK FRIDAY CLEARANCE 50% OFF + FREE SHIPPING | LIMITED STOCK', six colours; the product page lists no gift or bundle line, so those come from the campaign's client-approved facts only (Wouter 2026-10-23).

Compliance: only packet facts (60% off the set, three pieces, anti-theft design, scratch-proof leather, free US shipping, the campaign's bundle and gift facts), no first person, no countdown, no 'ends tonight', no sale end date.
